   MOTION TO WITHDRAW AS COUNSEL FOR INTERVENOR, SLOAN SISTERS
                         HOMESTEAD, LP

       COMES NOW, Sheldon E. Richie, Ryan W. Wood, and the firm Richie & Gueringer, P.C.

(collectively, “Counsel”), counsel of record for Intervenor, Sloan Sisters Homestead, LP (Party

546), and files this their Motion to Withdraw as Counsel for Intervenor, Sloan Sisters Homestead,

LP, and in support thereof respectfully shows:

       1.      Good cause exist for Counsel’s withdraw as Intervenor, Sloan Sisters Homestead,

LP has requested that Counsel end their engagement with and withdraw as counsel of record for

Intervenor, Sloan Sisters Homestead, LP, in this matter. Intervenor, Sloan Sisters Homestead, LP

consents to this Motion.

                             STATUS OF DEADLINES/SETTINGS

       2.      The Hearing on the Merits has already taken place in this matter on June 5, 2026 to

June 12, 2026. Following are the only deadlines in this matter pursuant to SOAH Order No. 35

(Dkt. No. 6597), which Intervenor, Sloan Sisters Homestead, LP has been notified of:

             a.    Briefs on Preliminary Order Issue 11 and 13 are due by October 7, 2026; and
             b.    Responses on the Briefs on Preliminary Order Issue 11 and 13 are due by
                   October 19, 2026.

                                              PRAYER
